title: ModuleTaskLaunchAdapter
responsibility: Prepare and clean an isolated provider launch while preserving exact model arguments, narrow local runtime reads and safe prelaunch diagnostics.

inputs.name: constructor.config
inputs.description: Trusted in-process qualification collaborator; omission fails closed. Never populated from task data, CLI options or environment.

inputs.name: run.argv
inputs.type: string[] logical provider command, exact arguments

inputs.name: run.execute
inputs.description: TaskProcessInput extends TaskRunInput with env?:Record<string,string|undefined>. Process collaborator must await all owned child exit before resolving/rejecting.

inputs.name: providerConfig
inputs.description: Trusted metadata-only provider config path discovery; individual rule files and exact directory are read-only.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: Before provider config discovery or sandbox preparation, require the trusted qualification callback to succeed; the production default rejects. Qualified synthetic or trusted-host execution retains exact argv, scope validation, runtime/config discovery and cleanup semantics. No unqualified provider is launched.

outputs.name: qualify
outputs.description: Await the trusted in-process qualification callback; absent or failing qualification rejects with the existing safe prelaunch diagnostic. run independently calls qualify again immediately before provider preparation.

errors.name: Missing scope, runtime unavailable or sandbox preparation rejection
errors.type: safe fixed Error with quotaRejected:false and diagnostic {category:"permission",phase:"prelaunch",nextAction:string}; no execute or provider usage
errors.description: Never expose arbitrary preparation error text; never launch an unrestricted fallback. Existing execution failures pass through after cleanup.

errors.name: Unqualified worker isolation
errors.description: Default or failed qualification prevents provider config discovery, sandbox preparation and execution. Qualification of real provider tool surfaces remains outstanding.
